keyword: best mcp server for image generation
title: Best MCP Server for Image Generation: 6 Options Tested (2026)

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.modelSupport: Multi-model catalog across image, video and audio nodes

quickstart.label: Add the hosted MCP server to Claude Code, then approve the OAuth consent screen:
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

quickstart.label: In Claude Desktop or claude.ai, add the same URL as a custom connector. Read-only tools (`list_workflows`, `list_models`, `get_execution`) cost nothing; `run_workflow` is the only one that spends credits.

tools.name: fal.ai MCP servers
tools.tagline: · community wrappers over fal's hosted inference catalog
tools.claudeConnection: Community MCP servers over stdio, authenticated with a FAL_KEY env var
tools.modelSupport: fal’s hosted inference catalog (image, video, audio)
tools.note: Community maintained, not vendor published. Other active wrappers include RamboRogers/fal-image-video-mcp. Verified 2026-09-01.

quickstart.label: Install command copied verbatim from the `enescanguven/fal-mcp` README:
quickstart.code: claude mcp add fal-ai -e FAL_KEY=your-fal-api-key -- npx -y fal-ai-mcp

tools.name: Replicate MCP
tools.tagline: · community wrapper over Replicate's prediction API
tools.claudeConnection: Community MCP servers only — no Replicate-published server
tools.modelSupport: Thousands of community and commercial models behind one API
tools.note: Community maintained. GongRzhe/Image-Generation-MCP-Server, the other server commonly cited, was archived on GitHub as of 2026-09-01.

quickstart.label: Install command copied verbatim from the `gerred/mcp-server-replicate` README:
quickstart.code:
# Using UV (recommended)
uv pip install mcp-server-replicate

tools.name: mcp-image
tools.tagline: · open source local server, bring your own provider keys
tools.claudeConnection: Local stdio MCP server, added with one `claude mcp add` command
tools.modelSupport: Nano Banana via Gemini, OpenAI GPT Image, and BytePlus Seedream
tools.note: Open source, so the server itself costs nothing — you bring and pay for your own provider keys.

quickstart.label: Install command copied verbatim from the `shinpr/mcp-image` README:
quickstart.code: claude mcp add mcp-image --env GEMINI_API_KEY=your-api-key --env IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR=/absolute/path/to/images -- npx -y mcp-image

tools.name: EverArt MCP
tools.tagline: · the archived reference implementation from the MCP project
tools.claudeConnection: Local stdio MCP server run with npx, authenticated with EVERART_API_KEY
tools.modelSupport: FLUX1.1, FLUX1.1-ultra, SD3.5, Recraft-Real and Recraft-Vector at 1024x1024
tools.note: ARCHIVED. Verified 2026-09-01: the server now lives in modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived, which GitHub reports as an archived repository. It still reads well as a minimal reference implementation, but nothing about it is maintained.

tools.name: ComfyUI MCP
tools.tagline: · exposes your own self-hosted ComfyUI graph to an agent
tools.claudeConnection: Local MCP server talking to your own ComfyUI over its HTTP/websocket API
tools.modelSupport: Whatever your own ComfyUI install has: checkpoints, LoRAs, custom nodes
tools.note: Open source, but you supply and run the GPU and the ComfyUI install behind it.

quickstart.label: Install steps copied verbatim from the `joenorton/comfyui-mcp-server` README:
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/joenorton/comfyui-mcp-server.git
cd comfyui-mcp-server
pip install -r requirements.txt
